Markets.title: US stocks today: Dow soars 600 pts, S&P, Nasdaq over 1% as Fed governor Waller's remarks ease rate hike fears
Markets.summary: US stocks rallied over 1% on Thursday, driven by Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller's comments that eased fears of further interest rate hikes. While major indexes and companies like Nvidia gained, Broadcom shares fell after its revenue forecast missed high expectations for artificial intelligence.

Markets.title: Gold jumps 2% as Fed Governor Waller's comments temper rate hike bets
Markets.summary: Gold prices rose over 2% after Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller indicated support for keeping interest rates steady if inflation continues to cool. This shift in expectations, combined with lower Treasury yields and a weaker dollar, drove the surge as investors awaited upcoming US jobs and inflation data.

Markets.title: Fed's Waller says safety premium for Treasuries is gone, pushing neutral rate higher
Markets.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller stated that the loss of the safety premium on U.S. Treasuries is driving the neutral interest rate higher, which could keep borrowing costs elevated. He also warned that the U.S. cannot grow its way out of its $40 trillion debt without reducing structural deficits.

Geo-Political.title: UN warns of 'supersized' El Niño as countries prepare for impact
Geo-Political.summary: The World Meteorological Organization warns that an incoming "supersized" El Niño weather phenomenon could disrupt global economies. Countries are currently preparing for the potential impacts of this severe natural event.

Geo-Political.title: Toxic wildfire haze spreads across South East Asia as 'super' El Niño intensifies
Geo-Political.summary: A toxic wildfire haze driven by an intensifying El Niño has spread across Southeast Asia, exposing millions to dangerous smog. Over 12,000 children have suffered respiratory issues as a result of the poor air quality.

Geo-Political.title: Feminist activist and journalist Gloria Steinem dies, aged 92
Geo-Political.summary: Feminist activist and journalist Gloria Steinem has died at the age of 92. Her foundation announced that she passed away peacefully at her New York City home surrounded by loved ones.

Geo-Political.title: Palestinian teens killed during settler attack on West Bank village, officials say
Geo-Political.summary: Palestinian officials report that Israeli settlers attacked the West Bank village of Al-Mughayyir, resulting in the deaths of Palestinian teenagers. Geo-Political.summary: Carla Jeffery, the Disney Channel star known for her role as cheerleader Bree in the *Zombies* movie franchise, has died at the age of 33. Her cause of death was not mentioned in the report.

Data & Insights.summary: Former RBI Governor Raghuram Rajan stated he has neither questioned nor endorsed India's official GDP growth figures. However, he expressed confusion over why this reported growth has not resulted in increased private investment, foreign direct investment, or job creation.

Data & Insights.summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal urged a nationwide push to help businesses utilize India's nine free trade agreements. These agreements provide preferential access to nearly two-thirds of global trade across economies representing about $60 trillion in GDP.

India.title: ISRO Successfully Launches GSLV F17 Rocket Carrying Imaging Satellite EOS 5
India.summary: On Friday, ISRO successfully launched the GSLV F17 rocket from the spaceport in Sriharikota, Andhra Pradesh. The pre-dawn mission carried the earth observation imaging satellite EOS-05 into space.

India.title: India Ready To Extend "Any Help" To End Russia-Ukraine War: S Jaishankar
India.summary: External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar stated that India is ready to provide any necessary assistance to help end the Russia-Ukraine war. During his visit, Jaishankar also met with President Volodymyr Zelenskyy to discuss strengthening bilateral cooperation between India and Ukraine.

India.title: Neglected Ambulance Forces Kerala Tribals To Carry Sick Across Forest
India.summary: Tribals in Kerala are forced to carry sick people across the forest because their local ambulance is neglected and out of service. Locals urge authorities to fix the administrative issues and repair the vehicle to end their severe medical transport hardships.

Shiromani Akali Dal leader Bikram Singh Majithia criticized the Aam Aadmi Party government following reports that the protester was assaulted.

General.title: Schools to close early for A66 crash funeral amid safety concerns

General.title: Fifa accuses Uefa of 'smear campaign' against Infantino

General.title: British army told to stop non-essential training exercises to save money
General.summary: The British army has ordered units not preparing for deployment to reduce non-essential training exercises. This directive aims to cut costs amid financial pressures.

General.title: Trump hints US would not back UK over Falkland Islands due to lack of Iran war support
General.summary: Donald Trump suggested the United States would not support the UK in a future conflict over the Falkland Islands. He based this stance on the UK's failure to assist his administration in its ongoing war with Iran.

General.title: Watch: Gloria Steinem dedicated her life to fight for women's equality
General.summary: Feminist icon and women's liberation movement leader Gloria Steinem has died at the age of 92 on Wednesday, according to her foundation. Steinem dedicated her entire life to fighting for women's equality.
